# Differential cases

Each case is a disagreement between markfmt and goldmark v2.0.2 that
`FuzzDifferential` found (design 11.5). The section of a case gives its
verdict and its rule: "fixed in markfmt", or "goldmark deviates" with the spec
section. The expected HTML is the output of `cmark --unsafe` 0.31.1.

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 4.6 and 6.6: a declaration starts with `<!` and an ASCII letter

goldmark needs an uppercase letter, as GitHub does (`../dialect.md`).

```````````````````````````````` example
x<!x>

<!doctype html>
.
<p>x<!x></p>
<!doctype html>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 4.6: `meta` is not in the tag list of HTML block kind 6

`<meta>` is an HTML block of kind 7, which cannot interrupt a paragraph.

```````````````````````````````` example
a
<meta>
.
<p>a
<meta></p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 4.6: a closing tag of `pre`, `script` or `style` starts HTML block kind 7

Kind 7 excludes these tag names only for an open tag.

```````````````````````````````` example
</script>

</pre>

</style>
.
</script>
</pre>
</style>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 4.7 and 6.3: an angle destination contains no unescaped `<`

```````````````````````````````` example
[a](<b<c>)

[d]: <e<f>

[d]
.
<p>[a](&lt;b<c>)</p>
<p>[d]: &lt;e<f></p>
<p>[d]</p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 4.3 and 4.7: a setext underline after link reference definitions alone is paragraph text

goldmark gives a thematic break, as commonmark.js does. markfmt follows cmark
(`../dialect.md`).

```````````````````````````````` example
[foo]: /url
---
.
<p>---</p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 5.3: a blank line at the end of a code block in a list item leaves the list tight

goldmark makes the list loose, as commonmark.js does. markfmt follows cmark
(design 2, commonmark.js regression 25).

```````````````````````````````` example
- ```
  a

- b
.
<ul>
<li>
<pre><code>a

</code></pre>
</li>
<li>b</li>
</ul>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 4.5: the class of an info word that starts with `language-` gets no second prefix

goldmark writes the class `language-language-r` (commonmark.js regression 28).

```````````````````````````````` example
```language-r
x
```
.
<pre><code class="language-r">x
</code></pre>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 4.7: a definition with its destination on a later line ends at the destination when the next line is not a title

goldmark also writes the destination line as paragraph text. With the
destination on the label's line, goldmark agrees (CM 210).

```````````````````````````````` example
[0]:
0
''0
.
<p>''0</p>
````````````````````````````````

## fixed in markfmt, spec section 2.3: a NUL in a code block or an HTML block is U+FFFD

markfmt wrote the NUL in the value of the block (design 8.4).

```````````````````````````````` example
    a␀b

<div>␀
.
<pre><code>a�b
</code></pre>
<div>�
````````````````````````````````

## fixed in markfmt, spec sections 2.3, 6.3 and 6.5: a NUL in an angle autolink or a link destination is U+FFFD

markfmt read the NUL as an ASCII control character, which ends both.

```````````````````````````````` example
<http://a␀>

[b](/␀)

[c]: /␀

[c]
.
<p><a href="http://a%EF%BF%BD">http://a�</a></p>
<p><a href="/%EF%BF%BD">b</a></p>
<p><a href="/%EF%BF%BD">c</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 6.6: an attribute value can contain U+FFFD

goldmark gives text for an open tag with U+FFFD in an attribute value, in
each of the three value forms.

```````````````````````````````` example
a <b c="�"> <d e='�'> <f g=�>
.
<p>a <b c="�"> <d e='�'> <f g=�></p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 2.1 and 6.2: a vertical tab, U+0085, U+2028 and U+2029 are not Unicode whitespace

goldmark reads them as whitespace for flanking, as Go's `unicode.IsSpace`
does, and gives text.

```````````````````````````````` example
a *a* *a* * a* *a *
.
<p>a <em>a</em> <em>a</em> <em> a</em> <em>a </em></p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 4.7 and 6.3: a parenthesis in a destination is escaped or in a balanced pair

goldmark accepts a destination with an open parenthesis that does not close
before a space or a line ending.

```````````````````````````````` example
[](a(b )

[c]: d(e

[c]
.
<p>[](a(b )</p>
<p>[c]: d(e</p>
<p>[c]</p>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec section 4.5: a content line of spaces in fenced code loses the fence and container indentation only

goldmark keeps the spaces of a line shorter than the fence indentation, and
removes the spaces beyond the indentation of a list item.

```````````````````````````````` example
  ```
 
```

- ```
   
.
<pre><code>
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>
<pre><code> 
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
````````````````````````````````

## goldmark deviates, spec sections 2.2 and 5.2: a tab after a nested list marker stops at a column counted from the start of the line

goldmark counts the columns of the tabs from the content of the outer list
item.

```````````````````````````````` example
* a
→*→→0

- b
  -→→1
.
<ul>
<li>a
<ul>
<li>
<pre><code>  0
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>b
<ul>
<li>
<pre><code>1
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
````````````````````````````````
